build_pynccl_communicator: build a PyNcclCommunicator instance with a process group, device, and optional NCCL library path
run_all_reduce: run an all-reduce operation on a tensor across processes using the PyNcclCommunicator
run_all_gather: run an all-gather operation to collect tensor data from all processes into one tensor
run_reduce_scatter: run a reduce-scatter operation to distribute reduced results across all processes
run_send_recv: run point-to-point send and receive operations between two processes on a given device
